prior_bootstrap_incident_root_cause: File 02 1.2.0 called SAUTH_Storage_Router::init() after successful activation without requiring includes/class-sauth-storage-router.php, producing a fatal on the next WordPress request.

live_1_3_0_activation_incident.root_cause: The deployed wp_sauth_passkeys user_status index was user_status(user_id,status,updated_at), while the canonical File 02 1.3.0 passkey verifier requires user_status(user_id,status). dbDelta did not contract the stale existing index, so passkey schema readiness failed and activation stopped safely.
live_1_3_0_activation_incident.permanent_fix: Runtime 1.3.1 adds a bounded idempotent reconciler that rewrites only the exact proven stale user_status index shape and fails closed on unknown layouts.

live_1_3_1_membership_route_contract_inc.root_cause: File 02 SA_Membership_Adapter invented sabri_profile, sabri_security_center and sabri_verification_status keys/slugs that do not exist in File 00's managed-page contract. File 00 canonically owns application, status, security and guardian pages.
live_1_3_1_membership_route_contract_inc.permanent_fix: Runtime 1.3.2 maps File 02 membership/profile completion to application + /membership-application/, membership security to security + /membership-security/, and verification/status to status + /membership-status/. It adds R339 regression coverage forbidding the invented sabri-* membership routes.

live_1_3_2_passkey_assurance_cycle_incid.root_cause: SAUTH_Passkey_Runtime::current_assurance() re-entered File 00 membership authorization after validating a session-bound passkey receipt. File 00 membership/capability evaluation itself consumes File 02 authentication assurance, creating a circular/re-entrant dependency. During that cycle the nested membership assertion could not complete as allow/active/not-suspended, so File 02 deleted the otherwise valid passkey receipt and Google linking later reported that no fresh passkey existed.
live_1_3_2_passkey_assurance_cycle_incid.permanent_fix: Runtime 1.3.3 makes current_assurance() a pure authentication-evidence projection based on the current user, current WordPress session token and valid session-bound receipt. It does not call File 00 membership authorization. Consumer/action boundaries retain independent authorization, including Google can_use_google() before fresh_passkey(). R340 permanently guards this separation.
excluded_root_causes: stale deployed source for the verified key files

artifact_policy: Exact-head CI may lint, regression-test and deterministically package this source candidate, but staging/live/operational claims remain separate gates and must not be inferred from repository success.
external_gates: Hostinger fresh install and supported upgrades
Deploy File 02 1.3.3 and verify exact deployed package/source parity
Create a fresh live passkey assurance and prove it survives File 00 capability/membership evaluation for the full five-minute bounded receipt lifetime unless independently invalidated
Live-retest Google Link start and Google callback completion without the false fresh-passkey rejection
Reconfirm the 1.3.2 canonical Membership Profile, Membership Security and Verification Status route correction against the exact deployed File 00 page map
Remove temporary diagnostic MU plugins and restore temporary WordPress debug configuration after evidence capture
Controlled Safe Mode exit/System Check and email-verification retest if Safe Mode is still active
Real production-domain WebAuthn authenticators and browser/device acceptance

cross_file_integration_evidence.scope: The 1.3.3 exact-head integration must re-prove all prior File 00/File 02 boundaries while R340 proves that File 02 authentication-assurance projection no longer re-enters File 00 authorization. Repository evidence is not live-resolution evidence.
required_proofs: fresh activation and exact runtime/schema markers
canonical File 00 page-key parity for application/status/security
exact deployed stale user_status index recovery

pre_route_fix_cross_file_integration_evi.scope: Historical pre-route-fix evidence only; it does not prove File 02 1.3.3.
